title: Greedy Longest-Match Tokenizer
prompt: Build a tokenizer for text using a vocabulary of nonempty strings. Implement `tokenize_longest_match(text, vocabulary, unknown='<UNK>') -> list[str]`. Scan left to right. At each position, emit the longest vocabulary token that matches there; if none matches, emit `unknown` and advance by one character. Return the token strings in order. The empty vocabulary is allowed, and empty text returns an empty list. Matching is case-sensitive on the original Unicode characters. Avoid testing every vocabulary entry at every position.

example.reasoning: At the first position both 'the' and 'there' match, so maximal munch chooses 'there'.
